pinpoints: Toelichting op de bewezenverklaring: Uitleg dienst nemen
holding: Acquittal as captain; conviction as crew member, five years. Service-taking interpreted to include serving; absence of authorization/naval status treated as constituent element rather than special defence.
limits: First-instance ruling on 2008/2009 facts; no exhaustive later-treatment audit. Old article4 numbering and procedural holdings not imported into current law. No separately verified judgment asserted for other nineteen units.
